## Use case / 使用场景

What are you trying to accomplish, and what blocks you today? / 你想完成什么，目前卡在哪里？

## Proposed behavior / 建议行为

Describe the command, skill behavior, template, or documentation change you want. / 描述希望新增或调整的命令、Skill、模板或文档行为。

## Alternatives / 替代方案

What alternatives have you considered? / 你考虑过哪些替代方案？

## Compatibility impact / 兼容性影响

Would this change an iteration ID, state machine, schema, directory convention, or skill trigger? / 是否会改变迭代 ID、状态机、schema、目录约定或 Skill 触发名？

## Additional context / 补充信息

Use only the fictional `example*` and `shared_be` names; do not reference a real project. / 示例只使用虚构的 `example*` 与 `shared_be`，不要引用真实项目。
